thought.text: Now deploy the app to the nginx document root:

reasoning_content:
Total is about 12MB, no problem. Let's deploy. Copy the folder and top-level HTML pages, and additionally add the top-level `data/` folder. The guide says "specific instances require a folder `data` at the top level (e.g., some pages in _examples/kosis_)" — so create /var/www/html/data (an empty top-level folder per the guide; the example data files are inside examples/*/data and are being copied together with examples).

After that, adjust the configuration: set elasticsearchBaseUrl to http://127.0.0.1:9200 (the guide says to adjust the base URL — localhost:9200 would also work since nginx is running on the same machine, but the browser will resolve it. In this container environment, "localhost:9200" would work with an in-container browser. The config default is already http://localhost:9200. Keep this.)

About the proxy URL: the default is http://localhost/~kirchman/... which is wrong for our deployment. Should I update baseConfig_withProxy.json and baseConfig_withProxyNoRestriction.json to point to http://localhost/php/dataExplorerProxy.php? The guide says "adjust the values in the config files... to the correct index name and base URL." Adjusting the proxy URL is reasonable and necessary to make the proxy-based pages work. The php proxy forwards to http://localhost:9200 (hardcoded) — this is fine.

Update both proxy configs to http://localhost/php/dataExplorerProxy.php.

After that, configure nginx for PHP.

action.command: cd /workspace && mkdir -p /var/www/html && cp -a config externalPackages i18n src php examples /var/www/html/ && cp -a index.html csvParse.html plausibilityCheck.html elasticsearchIndexAdministration.html logo.png /var/www/html/ && mkdir -p /var/www/html/data && ls -la /var/www/html/
